attributes.name: DurationInEvents
attributes.helptext: This controls how long the transition will last expressed in whole and fractional events.

attributes.name: DestEventSequenceOffset
attributes.helptext: Offset the destination synchronisation event track in relation to the source synchronisation event track.

attributes.name: DestStartEventIndex
attributes.helptext: Force a particular event from the destination synchronisation event track to be the destination start event (irrespective of the source start event).

attributes.name: UsingDestStartEventIndex
attributes.helptext: Method to determine the start event within the destination.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendPassThrough
attributes.helptext: Merge the event tracks together into one resulting output track without blending.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendIgnoreEventOrder
attributes.helptext: Ignore the order of events when blending means that events in the source tracks will be combined even if they have duration events in different orders.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendSameUserData
attributes.helptext: Duration events will only be blended together when they share the same user data.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendOnOverlap
attributes.helptext: Blend duration events when their durations overlap.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendWithinRange
attributes.helptext: Blend duration events when they occur within a specified range of one another.

attributes.name: ReversibleTransit
attributes.helptext: Make transition reversible.

attributes.name: ReverseControlParameter
attributes.helptext: Control parameter for transition reversing.

attributes.name: DeltaTrajSource
attributes.helptext: Specifies which child/children we will use to source our delta trajectory.

attributes.name: AdditiveBlendAttitude
attributes.helptext: When set, the rotations of Destination are added to Source.

attributes.name: AdditiveBlendPosition
attributes.helptext: When set, the rotations and positions of Destination are added to Source.

attributes.name: SphericallyInterpolateTrajectoryPosition
attributes.helptext: Spherically interpolate between the two trajectory positions inputs. The trajectory orientation is always spherically interpolated.

attributes.name: DeadblendBreakoutToSource
attributes.helptext: If turned on, a breakout transition to this transition's source will replace the source with a dead-reckoned animation.

attributes.name: DestinationSubState
attributes.helptext: An optional override for transitioning into sub-states other than the defaults.

attributes.name: BreakoutTransit
attributes.helptext: Allows this transition to execute while a transition to its source state is still in progress.

attributes.name: UseDeadReckoningWhenDeadBlending
attributes.helptext: If turned on, then the transition source is replaced with a dead-reckoned animation source. If turned off, then the last output of the transition source is maintained during the transition.
attributes.displayName: Use dead reckoning when dead blending

attributes.name: BlendToDestinationPhysicsBones
attributes.helptext: If turned on, then a normal blend between source and destination is performed on the transforms affected by the physics rig. If turned off, then the destination (physics) transforms are used.

helptext: Performs a transition blend between two states over a given period of time. Blends and outputs Events.
